messages:
deploy-bot: starting coordinated roll: api@v2.4.0, runtime@v4.8-rc1, router@v3.1.0-canary, console@v1.10.0. Window 2025-07-10 22:00->2025-07-11 02:00 UTC. Initial canary 2% us-east1. Pins: runtime=4.8-rc1, router=3.1.0-canary. Rollback: errors>1% OR p95>520ms for 5m -> cut.
maria: ack. Main ask: runtime rc1 has a new eviction heuristic; we need an explicit ttl override for canary to match prod behavior.
jess: api: no contract or header changes planned, but rerank relies on stable prefixes. Please avoid aggressive eviction during canary.
kyle: runtime: default eviction switched to adaptive mode in rc1; for safety I can force legacy TTL via ENV: RUNTIME_KV_TTL=35s for the canary pool. Will push now.
sam: console: we'll pause dashboard refresh and add `release/1767778000` tag. If TTL is 35s we should see minimal churn for metrics collectors.
oncall-sre: tightening watch: alertmanager rule set to auto-cut if errors>0.8% for 4m OR p95>480ms for 3m. First trigger -> automated traffic cut to fallback, then page.
maria: can deploy-bot include component SHAs and the helm/env overrides in the announce? makes rollback notes easier.
deploy-bot: added SHAs: api@v2.4.0 -> sha: z9y8x7w, runtime@v4.8-rc1 -> sha: q1w2e3r, router@v3.1.0 -> sha: t4y5u6i. Overrides: runtime canary ENV RUNTIME_KV_TTL=35s; router canary header_map=compat_v1.
kyle: pushed env to runtime-canary: `kubectl -n runtime set env sts/runtime-canary RUNTIME_KV_TTL=35s && kubectl -n runtime rollout restart sts/runtime-canary` logs show `INFO kv ttl=35s`.
jess: running short smoke: prefix + rerank + longseq. Script: `./smoke.sh --cases prefix,rerank,longseq --total 120 --rps 2` will post summary in 8m.
oncall-sre: watching. I'll execute the auto-cut commands if thresholds hit. Posting quick rollback commands here for ops:
```
# cut canary traffic to fallback
kubectl -n routing exec deploy/router-controller -- /bin/sh -c "./routectl set-weight api-canary --traffic 0 && ./routectl set-weight api-stable --traffic 100"
# rollback runtime to last stable
kubectl -n runtime set image sts/runtime-prod runtime=runtime:4.7.9
```
maria: release note bullets I'll push: - runtime ttl override for canary (35s) - router header_map compat flag - pinned runtime/router SHAs - canary ramp plan (2% -> 10% -> 40% with manual gates). I'll PR to release-notes repo and link this thread.
sam: console ready. dashboards muted and tagged. We'll unmute after steady 20m.
deploy-bot: canary started at 2% in us-east1. Will post ramp updates. Good luck!
